full_page.content:
1934, October
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 5.
Page 242 Cont.
Oct. 8 Mrs. Clara Monart - Keystone near 6 mile Rd. - 34 - with five children & husband, went to "healer" - was advised that she would cure her. The first time she went into the place some- thing about "seemed uncaney" Then she hoped that by going back & paying for her treatment she might be relieved of the "spell" she seemed to be suffering ..... This time was convinced that the woman is healer for Hell. She and her whole family have suffered as though under a curse ever since. From fear and agony at times has terrible perspirations. Get's blessing To-night and promises perpetual enrollment if better.
Page 243 Blank Page
Page 244
Oct.Mrs. Mary (Dort) Felker - 41 - baptized Catholic - raised a methodist but never joined any - finds out only a year ago that she was baptized in St. Vincent's Church, Detroit. Enrolled Sept. 26 last Now enrolls husband as against prejudice etc.
Arthur Gausche - 18 mos. had water on brain - Drs. wanted to oper- ate; parents had no means - now to astonishment is coming along fine - can not walk as yet but is bright & joyful & lively.
Mrs. Hockensmith - 42 - Baptist, heart & tuomer, has twice had per- tinitis ...
Mrs. Marg. Sullivan - 54 - infection of eyes.
Ed. D. Call (Mrs. McGee's Br) - 46 - talented but sadly given to drink ....
Mrs. Alida DeBrabander - 43 - operated for apendix .. . home in the ambulance To-day.
Helen Tomaszewski - 16 - Epileptic quite improving - Thanks. Blank Page
Page 245 Page 246 Oct. 13 John Mercurio - 51 - treated for exima in (Ford Hospital) terribly burned ....
Mrs. C. Reichman ... being sued for $25,000. - poor people themselves.
